title: Wholegrain Rice Salad with Peas, Roasted Vegetables and Feta
subtitle: with balsamic dressing
description: A hearty salad of brown rice, peas and roasted capsicum, sweet potato and onion, topped with feta and a balsamic dressing.

steps.text: Soak the rice in water for about 3 hours beforehand. Blanch the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes.
Bring the rice to the boil in a pot with 3.5 cups of water. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 30 to 40 minutes, until cooked but still al dente.

Place the 3 cm capsicum pieces, sweet potato cubes and quartered onions on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and roast for about 25 minutes, until golden and tender.
Mix the rice with the peas and roasted vegetables in a bowl.
Whisk the dressing ingredients (2 tbsp olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper), pour over the salad and mix. Scatter over the crumbled feta and serve.
